idea: A coding agent should declare work complete only when the requested final repository state is actually supported by owner-level acceptance evidence.
mechanism_hypothesis: An exact prompt-only requirement-ledger and final-state reconciliation policy can reduce false completion without materially reducing accepted work or replacing honest completion with abstention.
intended_scope: prompt-only completion policy on one pinned Codex coding stack
small deterministic Python repository tasks with owner-controlled acceptance predicates
bounded internal enable, selective-route, reject, or retest decision
known_non_goals: transfer to other models, CLIs, repositories, organizations, or task populations
independent replication or downstream production outcome
a generic lifecycle framework or Contract v1

lineage.change_summary: First concept revision for the alpha.9 Completion Integrity controlled-factor study; distinct from the historical Truthful Completion skill protocol.
